name: croc_bounding
description: Young crocodile galloping (bounding) on land, side view facing right: slim light olive-tan body with dark cross-bands, back arched, all four legs off the ground (fronts reaching forward, hinds kicked back), tail lifted, jaws closed, small dust puff under it and motion lines behind. Small and light, not a giant. Anchor bottom-centre (ground y=0); bbox x -300..300, y -220..0.
